title: Update English README for final release
description: Update `README.md` to match the implemented 1.2.0 artifact, commands, methods, security/resource guidance, verification, and recovery behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: README identifies Xistance Panel 1.2.0 and supported Node/Ubuntu/architecture requirements
Install docs use the pinned one-line prebuilt-artifact command and explain checksum/provenance verification
All nine methods and truthful status semantics are documented
Low-RAM/1-vCPU, backup/restore, update/rollback, troubleshooting, and browser/API checks are documented
No source-build-on-VPS claim or real secret remains

steps.details: Read final scripts, workflows, manifest format, env template, and current README; list every stale or missing claim with file/line evidence.
Rewrite only the affected sections, preserving useful project/tunnel explanations and adding final release/install/operations sections.
Run shell/help/manifest/doc consistency checks and inspect rendered Markdown for broken links/placeholders.
Run the documentation consistency check and record output.

technicalNotes: Documentation must distinguish prebuilt artifact from a native self-contained executable and state Node.js 22 as a runtime prerequisite.
